plan: A marksman who swoops onto her target with her ultimate and detonates her plasma marks.
aSurveiller: Her R (Killer Instinct). She dashes to a champion marked by her plasma: don't let your allies get marked.
contrer: Dodge her W: it marks you and gives her the range of her R.
Stay grouped: her volley (Q) is stronger on an isolated target.
Engage her after her R: it's her only dash.
forces: Dashes onto her target with her R.
Turns invisible with her evolved E.
faiblesses: Relies on her R to reposition.

sorts.P: Her attacks stack plasma that explodes.
sorts.Q: Volley of missiles, stronger on an isolated target.
sorts.R: Dashes to a marked champion with a shield.

momentFort: Strong in the mid and late game.
